dataset.name: trials.csv
dataset.note: Synthetic TRIAL-* IDs; public program names; no patient data.

dimensions.name: decomposition
dimensions.explanation: Some composite values are decomposed (e.g., ClinicalTrial.has_phase, has_sponsor), but many object-valued attributes remain flat strings (e.g., Trial.sponsor, Trial.site, Artifact.artist, Book.author).
issues: Trial.sponsor and Trial.site are string literals despite Sponsor and Location/Site entities existing.
Artifact.artist and Book.author remain string attributes even though Author/Person entities exist.
Many location-related fields (Depot.located_at, Hub.located_at, Yard.is_located_in) are flat strings rather than relationships to Place entities.
Panel.lab, Panel.kit, Panel.ready are string fields while Lab, Kit, and ReadyStatus entities exist.

dimensions.name: reusability
dimensions.explanation: Several shareable concepts are modeled as entities (Country, Drug, Sponsor, Department, Term), but many others remain string attributes or are not consistently reused.
issues: Trial.sponsor is a string, not linked to Sponsor/Organization entity.
Artifact.artist and Book.author are strings instead of Person/Organization references.
CourseOffering.campus is a string while Campus entity exists.
Vehicle.depot is a string while Depot entity exists.

dimensions.name: hierarchy
dimensions.explanation: Only a few subClassOf relationships are declared (e.g., AccountManager->Person, City->Place), but most natural hierarchies are missing.
issues: Sponsor, Agency, Department, Lab, and Vendor are not subclasses of Organization.
ClinicalTrial and Trial are separate flat types with no hierarchy or equivalence link.
Artwork is not related to Artifact despite overlapping fields.
Product, Part, InventoryItem, and InventoryLine have overlapping semantics but no shared supertype.

dimensions.name: predicate_consistency
dimensions.explanation: Multiple predicate names are used for the same semantic relationship across the ontology, causing duplication and inconsistency.
issues: located_at vs stored_at (Part), located_at vs is_located_in (Asset/Yard).
has_department vs is_in_department (Course), offered_by vs offerer (Offering/CourseOffering).
has_status vs in_status (Product), supplied_by vs has_supplier (Product), has_author vs written_by (Book).
identifies vs identified_bench/identified_kit (identifiers), for_product vs priced_product (ListPrice).

dimensions.name: entity_first
dimensions.explanation: Some real-world references are modeled as entities (e.g., ClinicalTrial.has_sponsor, Product.has_supplier), but many key references remain string literals.
issues: Trial.sponsor and Trial.site are string literals instead of links to Sponsor/Site entities.
Artifact.artist and Book.author are dead-end strings despite Author entity existing.
Asset.operator_name duplicates has_operator, indicating a string fallback.
Panel.lab and Panel.ready are strings despite Lab and ReadyStatus entities.

dimensions.name: type_naming
dimensions.explanation: Most type names are PascalCase, singular, and descriptive, but there are a few violations such as the lowercase 'number' type and overly generic names.
issues: Type 'number' is lowercase and appears to be a primitive rather than a class.
Generic types like 'Thing', 'OfferedThing', and 'Role' are vague and not self-descriptive.
Duplicate/ambiguous pairs like 'Trial' and 'ClinicalTrial' or 'Artifact' and 'Artwork' create naming confusion.

weak_points: Consolidate duplicate predicates (located_at/stored_at, has_status/in_status, offered_by/offerer, has_author/written_by, etc.) into a single canonical property for each relationship.
Replace string reference fields (Trial.sponsor, Trial.site, Artifact.artist, Book.author, Panel.lab, Panel.ready) with object properties to the existing entity types.
Introduce missing subClassOf relationships: make Sponsor, Agency, Department, Lab, Vendor subclasses of Organization; link ClinicalTrial/Trial and Artifact/Artwork where appropriate.
Resolve duplicate/overlapping types (e.g., Product, Part, InventoryItem; ClinicalTrial, Trial; Artifact, Artwork) by merging or creating explicit hierarchies.
Remove or rename non-entity types such as 'number' and generic stubs like 'Thing' and 'Role' to improve semantic clarity.
